description: This PHP source file defines the PackageController class, which manages package-related operations such as searching, retrieving, downloading, and managing software packages, releases, categories, documentation, and updates within the SuiteCRM module installation framework. It handles AJAX requests, interacts with PackageManager and related classes, and outputs JSON-encoded responses.

classes.name: PackageController
classes.description: A controller class that manages package installation, retrieval, search, and update processes in SuiteCRM, handling client requests and interacting with underlying package management classes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the PackageController, creating an instance of PackageManager.

methods.name: performBasicSearch
methods.description: Handles basic search requests for packages, returning matching package data.

methods.name: getPackages
methods.description: Retrieves packages belonging to a specified category, returning XML data.

methods.name: getReleases
methods.description: Fetches release information for a given package and category, returning JSON with release details.

methods.name: getPromotion
methods.description: Retrieves promotion details from the package repository.

methods.name: download
methods.description: Downloads a specified package release and performs setup if successful.

methods.name: getCategories
methods.description: Retrieves subcategories under a parent category.

methods.name: getNodes
methods.description: Gets modules associated with a category, typically for module loader purposes.

methods.name: checkForUpdates
methods.description: Checks for available updates for installed packages and patches, returning update information.

methods.name: getLicenseText
methods.description: Retrieves license text for a specified file.

methods.name: getPackagesInStaging
methods.description: Gets the list of packages in the staging area waiting for installation.

methods.name: performInstall
methods.description: Performs installation of a package from the staging area.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Handles user authentication for the package depot.

methods.name: getDocumentation
methods.description: Retrieves documentation associated with a package or release.

methods.name: rmMetaFile
methods.description: Removes metadata files related to a package, such as manifest or icon files.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a package file and associated metadata files.
